rationale: C13 plausibly supplied a concrete administrative drafting template for the child: establishment of a named interagency body, specification of agency officials as members, authorization of alternates, assignment of coordinating duties, agency-furnished assistance, and reporting obligations. Several formulations are closely parallel, and the operative sequence is materially similar despite the bodies serving different subjects. C02 and C11 share portions of this machinery, but less completely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the United States Section of the St. Lawrence River Joint Board of Engineers, composed of two members and hereinafter referred to as the United States Section.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: there is hereby established an Operations' Coordinating Board, hereinafter referred to as the Board
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same establishment-and-defined-name formulation for an interagency body.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of the Army and the Chairman of the Federal Power Commission are hereby designated members. Each may designate an alternate to act for him as member of the United States Section.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall have as members the following... Each head of agency... may provide for an alternate member who shall serve as a member of the Board in lieu of the regular member
shared_material.explanation: Both designate senior agency officials as members and expressly provide for alternate members.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The United States Section shall represent the Government of the United States on the Joint Board of Engineers... and is authorized to act with the Canadian Section in the approval of the plans and specifications... and the programs of construction thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Board shall... advise with the agencies concerned as to... their detailed operational planning responsibilities... the coordination of the interdepartmental aspects of the detailed operational plans... [and] the timely and coordinated execution of such policy and plans
shared_material.explanation: The operative duties in both orders center on reviewing or coordinating plans and their execution.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Department of the Army and the Federal Power Commission are authorized to furnish such assistance, including facilities, supplies and personnel, to the United States Section as may be consonant with law and necessary for the purpose of effectuating this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Consonant with law, each agency represented on the Board shall, as may be necessary for the purpose of effectuating this order, furnish assistance to the Board... Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Board
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, closely shared language assigning represented agencies to furnish legally permissible assistance to effectuate the order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The United States Section shall submit its final report to the President upon the completion of construction and shall submit such Interim reports as may appear to be desirable.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall from time to time make reports to the National Security Council with respect to the carrying out of this order
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the body's substantive provisions with an ongoing reporting requirement, though the recipient differs.
